hints.title: Point Calculation
hints.text: Each win awards three points and each draw awards one point, while losses award zero points.

hints.title: Standard Competition Ranking
hints.text: Use the rank window function ordered by total points descending to handle ties with shared positions.

hints.title: Sorting Presentation
hints.text: Sort the final leaderboard primarily by points descending and secondarily by team name alphabetically.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT
    team_id,
    team_name,
    wins * 3 + draws * 1 AS points,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wins * 3 + draws * 1 DESC) AS position
FROM TeamStats
ORDER BY points DESC, team_name ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Sorting by points and window rank computation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Correlated subqueries to compute relative ranks cause quadratic runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies standard window rank function with correct order criteria.
